Read-only audit. No code changes, no commits, no working-tree modifications.

- Check whether the module is consumed by any other test target (grep for attempts_mod across tests/) and confirm how its unit tests execute (the file compiles as its own integration-test crate)
- Record an explicit verdict per parent task: implemented / partially implemented / missing

## Acceptance

- Every parent task carries an explicit verdict backed by verbatim command output (grep, wc, ls) recorded in the notes
- Zero working-tree modifications; the audit is strictly read-only
